art_direction: 浅绯粉底湖蓝低弧眼，左浅右开，柔和左望。
composition_variation: Make the pair a little shallower overall, with the lower left eye still less open than the right. Keep both lower contours rounded and the upper lids gently arched, never straight bars. Large black pupils remain joined to the lids and share a soft leftward gaze. Matching lake-blue bands widen near the outer bottom curves; each pupil holds one elongated ivory glint. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
